title: Evidence IR
description: Intermediate Representation for normalized evidence entries in the AIR Evidence Store

id.description: Unique hash identifier for this evidence entry

collector.description: Name of the collector that produced this evidence (e.g., foundry-broadcast, test-coverage, source-analysis)

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the evidence was observed

artifact.description: Path or URI of the source artifact

digest.description: SHA-256 hash of the artifact content

status.description: Objective status of the observed artifact

metadata.description: Additional structured properties specific to the collector type
